about_the_game:
Seven Nexus follows the story of Grey, a man who dies a sudden death and learns he’s an anomaly - a Nexus Being. No one knows how he lived or died, and as such, he can’t be judged by Purgatory. He doesn’t belong in either Heaven or Hell.

To decide his fate, Grey must travel back to the human realm and complete Seven Trials, accompanied by two unlikely Guardians: an angel and a devil. Bound by the Supreme Being, they can guide, support, and tempt Grey but never interfere. Only Grey’s choices, virtuous or sinful, can shape the path ahead.

Walk beside Grey as he makes difficult decisions that affect more than just his own fate. Grow closer to his Guardians and uncover their stories and secrets. Forge bonds that may lead him to his true calling, and perhaps, to something even more meaningful… love.

Seven Nexus features a fully playable Prologue, seven immersive Chapters, and a powerful Epilogue. Across two distinct branching paths, you’ll experience deeply personal, story-rich moments with Grey’s potential love interests - Haelo and Horne. Every choice you make shapes the journey toward one of several dramatic, emotional endings: ascend to Heaven, descend to Hell, or forge a fate that’s entirely your own. Grow close to Haelo in a world of gentle intimacy and quiet longing or surrender to the thrilling chaos and seductive fire of Horne!

It showcases fully illustrated, hand-drawn art, including detailed character sprites with multiple clothing arrangements, poses, and expressions; immersive backgrounds that bring the human and supernatural world to life; and full-scene illustrations capturing special character moments, heated fanservice and versatile erotic scenes.

The game also features an evocative original soundtrack, composed specifically for Seven Nexus, designed to enhance every moment, from quiet intimacy to high-stakes tension, and fully immerse players in its unique atmosphere.

With its striking visuals, emotionally rich storytelling, and carefully crafted audio experience, the game offers a tantalizing glimpse into the world of Seven Nexus, leaving players eager to uncover the full story, make deeper connections, and face the Trials ahead

!

As Grey navigates the Seven Trials, he’ll have the chance to grow closer, and maybe fall in love with two wildly different companions. Haelo, a soft-spoken angel with a heart full of wonder and secrets of his own. And Horne, a devilish force of nature whose smirk hides more than just temptation.

Each route offers a distinct experience: Haelo’s path explores self-discovery and the aching sweetness of slow-burning affection, while Horne’s is a thrilling dive into desire, rebellion, and learning to love through conflict.

Experience Grey’s journey through the Seven Trials, each a unique chapter that challenges his beliefs, desires, and sense of self. Every choice you make will shape his destiny. At the end, will he ascend to Heaven or descend to Hell? Or perhaps… find his true calling and forge a completely different fate?

Each main character sprite features a variety of dynamic poses, multiple clothing variations, and a rich range of facial expressions, allowing every emotion, reaction, and nuance to come to life in dialogue and scenes.

Dive deeper into Grey’s journey with stunning cutscene illustrations that capture emotional turning points, playful chaos, and unforgettable moments with Haelo and Horne. Each scene is hand-drawn and fully rendered, tailored to highlight every line of dialogue with expressive visuals that enrich the storytelling. Stylish mini-illustrations also bring important moments to life, whether they're romantic, haunting, or hilariously awkward. All artwork is stored in a custom-made game gallery, so you can revisit your favorite scenes anytime!

Experience the richly imagined world of Seven Nexus through meticulously crafted background art that brings each setting to life. From the familiarity of the human realm to the haunting stillness of Purgatory, the divine radiance of Heaven, and the twisted grandeur of Hell.

After each Trial, Grey’s energy will need to be restored before he can continue his journey. Depending on your choices, the renewal may come from Haelo, eager to hold Grey with care and tenderness, or from Horne, who might offer relief in his own dark, domineering way. Each Nexus Ritual culminates in a beautifully hand-drawn, rendered and voice-acted erotic scene. It will deliver an intimate and steamy experience true to your path! Your interaction and influence to your Guardians determine their 'role' to take for the Nexus Ritual, guaranteeing a 'versatile' sexual experience throughout the story!

Your choices will determine Grey’s eternal fate. Will he go to Heaven, Hell, or forge a path entirely his own? Every decision matters, not just for Grey, but for his Guardians as well. How deeply they bond with him, and whether it blossoms into something more, lies in your hands. Unravel the truth behind their pasts, the Trials, and the realms beyond. There are many secrets waiting!

The game features a fully original soundtrack, composed exclusively for Seven Nexus by our talented composer. From tender emotional moments to heart-pounding tension, each track is carefully crafted to match the story’s shifting moods. Also, enjoy unique, character-specific themes that capture the essence of Haelo and Horne!

DISCLAIMER:

This game / visual novel is strictly for ADULT AUDIENCES ONLY (R-18). It contains sexually explicit scenes, imagery and graphic language which may be considered offensive by some viewers (NSFW). All sexual activity portrayed in this game is consensual and all characters portrayed are 18 YEARS OF AGE AND ABOVE.

This game is a work of fiction. Names, characters, organizations, places, and events are all products of the author’s imagination and used in a fictitious manner. Any resemblance to the aforementioned subjects is purely coincidental.

The plot of Seven Nexus centers around a character dealing with heavy topics: death, prostitution, harassment, alcohol use, abandonment, bullying. 

It also focuses on a matter of faith as it follows a character who makes either virtuous or sinful choices to determine whether he goes to Heaven or Hell. 

Furthermore, it features sexually explicit conversations, explicit nudity, sex, and bodily fluids. A fictional human engages in sexual acts with supernatural creatures: an angel and a devil.
